adjustments.title: Downtown Line ends early
adjustments.note: DTL services end around 11:30 PM on this affected Friday. Station-specific final departures are not published in the announcement, so the calculator uses an earlier conservative estimate.

adjustments.title: Sengkang West Loop inner direction closed
adjustments.note: West Loop trains from Sengkang towards SW1 Cheng Lim are suspended. The outer direction via SW8 Renjong remains available.

adjustments.title: National Day Eve extended service
adjustments.note: Selected SMRT departure anchors are extended for National Day Eve. Times away from the published anchors are conservatively propagated and remain estimates.
